description: This file defines the CharUtils class which provides static utility methods for character processing, including case conversion, code point handling, and character classification, primarily for Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic characters.

classes.name: CharUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for character manipulation and classification.

methods.name: isAsciiUpper
methods.description: Checks if a character code is an uppercase ASCII letter.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a character code to its lowercase equivalent, handling ASCII and special quote characters.

methods.name: toBaseLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a character code to its base lowercase form, considering combined characters.

methods.name: getCodePointCount
methods.description: Counts the number of code points in an array up to a null terminator or specified size.

methods.name: toBaseCodePoint
methods.description: Maps a character code to its base code point if it is a combined character.

methods.name: latin_tolower
methods.description: Converts a Latin character code to lowercase (implementation not shown).
